mapper.sql: id, line_id, provider_pattern_id, service_type, valid_from, valid_to, active, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stop_pattern ( id, line_id, provider_pattern_id, service_type, valid_from, valid_to, active ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{lineId}, #{providerPatternId}, #{serviceType}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{active} ) ON CONFLICT (line_id, provider_pattern_id, valid_from) DO UPDATE SET service_type = EXCLUDED.service_type, valid_to = EXCLUDED.valid_to, active = EXCLUDED.active, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO stop_pattern_stop ( stop_pattern_id, stop_sequence, stop_id, pickup_allowed, dropoff_allowed ) VALUES
( #{patternStop.stopPatternId}, #{patternStop.stopSequence}, #{patternStop.stopId}, #{patternStop.pickupAllowed}, #{patternStop.dropoffAllowed} )
ON CONFLICT (stop_pattern_id, stop_sequence) DO UPDATE SET stop_id = EXCLUDED.stop_id, pickup_allowed = EXCLUDED.pickup_allowed, dropoff_allowed = EXCLUDED.dropoff_allowed
mapper.select: SELECT sps.stop_pattern_id AS "stopPatternId", sps.stop_sequence AS "stopSequence", sps.stop_id AS "stopId", ts.public_name AS "stopName", sps.pickup_allowed AS "pickupAllowed", sps.dropoff_allowed AS "dropoffAllowed" FROM stop_pattern_stop sps INNER JOIN transit_stop ts ON ts.id = sps.stop_id WHERE sps.stop_pattern_id = #{stopPatternId} ORDER BY sps.stop_sequence ASC
